source_text: Epidemiologically, FGM correlates with immediate risks like hemorrhage and sepsis, plus long-term issues including urinary retention, infertility, and heightened maternal/neonatal mortality during delivery (e.g., fourfold increase in postpartum hemorrhage), with no offsetting benefits.
